name: Asphalt Force Field Benchmark
description: Evaluates force fields on asphalt by comparing computed density, viscosity, glass transition temperature, diffusion coefficients, cohesive energy density, and molecular structure metrics to reference data.
evaluation_method: error-based (RMSE / MAE) and correlation (R²); often reported as a composite error score aggregated across properties
general_score_metric: composite_error_score (aggregated RMSE/MAE across evaluated properties; lower is better)
notes: Non-LLM benchmark based on molecular simulations/experiments. Computationally expensive (MD/MC simulations), sensitive to simulation protocol and force-field parametrization, and limited in chemical diversity (focused on asphalt systems). Risk of metric sensitivity to dataset / simulation hyperparameters; low contamination risk for LLMs.
